proposals.title: Core branded integer types and ADR-004 rounding enforcement
proposals.why_now: CanonicalEncoder is the only substantive code in packages/core. ADR-003 (TRAVADO) fully specifies Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint types and Tick as a branded safe-integer number — no DEFINIR item affects these definitions. ADR-004 requires rounding mode enforcement to be a compile-time or lint-blocking error, and the enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR. Both must land together because the types are useless without safe division semantics. Every downstream FASE-1 package (domain, world, application, contracts) is blocked at the type level until these exist — they are the shallowest dependency with the widest fan-out.

proposals.title: Positional RNG and ADR for hash function
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 (TRAVADO) prohibits any PRNG with state and requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. INV-02 — described by the spec as 'the most important test of the project' — requires price(asset, t) computed directly to equal price(asset, t) reached by advancing tick by tick. This invariant is structurally impossible without a positional RNG. All namespaces in §3 ADR-002 (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, bot.decision, npc.tip.truth, npc.tip.payload, quest.roll, venue.liquidity) must be typed constants. Writing any hash without this ADR would make the entire rand() interface retroactively incorrect.

proposals.title: Multi-commodity double-entry ledger
proposals.why_now: The ledger is the source of truth for all economic state. INV-04 through INV-07 require it to exist and be provably correct before any order processing, tick loop, or save/replay work can be meaningful. The interface is fully specified in §6: Transaction, Entry, Account, per-commodity balance-zero invariant (not aggregate), causationId on every transaction, rounding residue posted to world:rounding_residue:<COMMODITY>. The domain package is entirely a stub. This is its first substantive deliverable and it depends only on IDEA-001.

proposals.title: Price generator with two assets and two noise layers
proposals.why_now: INV-02 is the spec's self-described most important test: price(asset, t) computed directly must equal the value obtained by advancing tick by tick for any t. The fractal octave construction (trendLayer + idiosyncraticNoise) is the first substantive use of the positional RNG and of fixed-point arithmetic in the world package. Two noise layers and two assets (ORB and NEXA) satisfy the minimum for FASE-1 acceptance. An ADR must first resolve the DEFINIR item for octave count, periods, and amplitudes, and must decide how to implement sinusoidal-equivalent interpolation without Math.sin/cos/exp/log since INV-19 requires cross-platform bit identity under the same V8.

repository_assessment.current_state: Infrastructure and tooling are complete: monorepo skeleton, TypeScript strict mode, determinism lint (§13), dependency-boundary lint (§14.5), and CanonicalEncoder with ADR-009 accepted (TASK-0009 approved). All eight packages, four desktop apps, and three tools exist as typed stubs. No domain logic has been implemented: packages/core exports only CanonicalEncoder; world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, and ui are export{} stubs; all Electron apps are empty; tools/replay and tools/bench have no implementation.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core lacks branded nominal integer types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick) and the division helper with explicit rounding modes required by ADR-003 and ADR-004. Until these exist — along with the ADR-004 DEFINIR decision on enforcement mechanism — no code in world, domain, or application can be correctly typed or implemented.

warnings: ADR-004 requires that invoking division without an explicit rounding mode be 'um erro de compilação ou erro de lint bloqueante', but the enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR. This must be resolved by ADR before any core arithmetic is written because the choice (typed divWithMode helper vs custom lint rule over the / operator on branded types) constrains the entire arithmetic API surface. Implementing branded types without the ADR would produce an incomplete and non-conforming deliverable.

ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. The spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a but this is a recommendation, not a decision. Once any StateHash exists that depends on rand(), the hash function is effectively frozen — changing it retroactively invalidates every reference StateHash value used by INV-01 replay comparisons and CI gate step 5.

The price generator in §5.1 requires behavior equivalent to sinusoidal interpolation across octave blocks, but ADR-003 (TRAVADO) and §13 forbid Math.sin, Math.cos, Math.exp, Math.log, and Math.pow in pure packages. INV-19 requires cross-platform bit identity under the same Electron/V8 version. The approach (fixed-point interpolation with integer trigonometric tables vs linear interpolation between sampled vertices) must be decided by ADR before implementation begins, since any choice that differs between implementations would break INV-02 and INV-19.
